case_name: Harshvardhan Sarangapani vs Kotak Mahindra Prime Limited & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Kotak Mahindra Prime Limited & Anr — Respondents

facts_of_case: Complaint filed by respondent Kotak Mahindra Private Limited under Section 138 of Negotiable Instruments Act. Appellant was sentenced to pay fine and undergo imprisonment. Appeal against this order.

legal_principles.principle: Besides convicting the accused in check bounce cases, compensation to the complainant should also be awarded so as to meet the ends of justice.
legal_principles.held: Court recommended to the Trial Courts that besides convicting the accused in check bounce cases, compensation to the complainant should also be awarded so as to meet the ends of justice.

legal_principles.principle: A victim has a right to prefer an appeal against any order passed by the court acquitting the accused or convicting him for lesser offence or inadequate compensation.
legal_principles.held: Section 372 of the Code, which was inserted w.e.f. 31.12.2009, gives a right to the victim to prefer an appeal against any order passed by the court acquitting the accused or convicting him for lesser offence or inadequate compensation and such appeal lies to the court to which an appeal ordinarily lies against an order of conviction of such court.

legal_principles.principle: A person convicted on a trial held by a Metropolitan Magistrate can file an appeal to the court of Sessions.
legal_principles.held: In view of the provisions of sub-section (3)of Section 374 of the Code, a person convicted on trial held by a Metropolitan Magistrate can file an appeal to the court of Sessions.

keywords: imprisonment till rising of the court
SI for two months in default
Section 2 of Code of Criminal Procedure
